question: What is the female literacy rate in India, as per the 2011 census?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**0.6546**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **female literacy rate** in India as per the **2011 Census** is **65.46%**.
 
• The **female literacy rate** reflects the percentage of women aged 7 and above who are able to read and write with understanding.
 
• It is an important indicator of a country's **educational development** and the progress of women in society.
 
• The **overall literacy rate** in India, as per the 2011 Census, was **74.04%**, with male literacy at **82.14%** and female literacy at **65.46%**.
 
• States like **Kerala** and **Mizoram** have the highest female literacy rates, while states like **Bihar** and **Rajasthan** have the lowest.
 
• Efforts to improve the female literacy rate include government initiatives such as the **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao** scheme, the **National Literacy Mission**, and the **Right to Education Act**.
 
• Improving female literacy is linked to **economic growth**, better **health outcomes**, and **social empowerment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Since the other options are numerical values, there is no specific explanation required for them.
 
• However, it is important to understand that the female literacy rate is a critical metric that reflects the **educational disparity** between genders.
 
• India has made significant progress in literacy over the years, but more targeted efforts are needed to reduce the **gender gap** in education.
 
• Key government efforts include the **Saakshar Bharat Mission**, which aims to achieve 80% literacy levels and focus on **women’s education**.
 
• Exam aspirants should also remember that the Census of India is conducted every **10 years** and provides vital statistics on population, literacy, employment, and other socio-economic indicators.
